name: Eastwall Tower
summary: Eastwall Tower is a ruined Lordaeron scout tower situated in the Eastern Plaguelands near the eastern road. Sacked during the Third War when the Scourge swept across the kingdom, its remains now serve as a vital vantage point fought over by Alliance and Horde forces seeking a foothold in the infected wilderness.

sections.title: A Ruined Watch on the Border
sections.body: Built as a border sentinel for the kingdom of Lordaeron, Eastwall Tower once watched over travelers heading toward the far reaches of the realm. When the Scourge invaded during the Third War, the outpost was crushed along with the surrounding settlements, leaving shattered stone arches and burnt timber behind. Now, with the Lich King's armies still infesting the region, the tower's elevated position makes it an indispensable forward post. Vanguard scouts from both the Alliance and the Horde clash violently over its ramparts, seeking to secure supply lines and bolster regional control against the surrounding horrors.

faq.q: What was Eastwall Tower before it fell?
faq.answer: Eastwall Tower was originally a defensive scout tower constructed by the Kingdom of Lordaeron. It formed part of the regional border watch network, safeguarding trade routes and outlying farms before the Third War brought about Lordaeron's fall.

The tower was destroyed by the Scourge during Prince Arthas Menethil's conquest and the subsequent undead ravaging of Lordaeron. Undead monstrosities smashed its defenses, leaving the defenders dead and the structure in ruins.

faq.q: Why are the Alliance and Horde fighting over these ruins?
faq.answer: Even in ruins, the tower commands high ground along the eastern roadways of the Plaguelands. Both factions seek to fortify their forward positions, protect supply lines, and establish staging grounds against the Scourge without ceding territory to their mortal rivals.

faq.q: Is the tower safe to rest at?
faq.answer: The tower is actively contested and never truly secure. Whichever faction currently holds the beacon may station sentries there, but wild Scourge forces roam close by and rival champions frequently launch skirmishes to seize control.

angles.text: For the Alliance, retaking Eastwall Tower honors the fallen soldiers of Lordaeron and secures the approach to Light's Hope Chapel against Scourge and Horde incursions alike.
Securing Eastwall Tower establishes a vital forward outpost in contested northern lands, ensuring Horde forces are not trapped or cut off by Alliance expeditions.
